hazards.evidence: Hardwood flooring throughout the living area has a high-gloss finish that creates visible glare/reflections, which can reduce traction visibility and increase slip risk, especially with a walker.
The exterior front door appears to have a raised sill/threshold typical of exterior doors, which could pose a trip hazard or difficulty for walker wheels.
